newsitem.title: USA: PageNet to redeem $200 mln 11-3/4 pct debt.
newsitem.headline: PageNet to redeem $200 mln 11-3/4 pct debt.

text.p: Paging Network Inc on Monday said it will redeem all of its outstanding $200 million 11-3/4 percent senior subordinated notes due May 15, 1997.
The redemption and a $12 million pre-payment premium will be paid for with funds borrowed under the company's $1.0 billion bank credit agreement.

PageNet had previously said it will record an extraordinary loss of $15 million in the second quarter of 1997 as a result of the redemption. The company anticipates an incremental savings in interest expense of about $4 million this year.
PageNet is a wireless messaging company.
